tasks.title: Nested nodes sharing one focus handle
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Found while migrating RayX (s08): a RayX text control's host tracks the same focus handle as gpux's inner `EditableText`, both with roles, so a focused field claimed the tree's focus twice and debug builds panicked ("set_focus called more than once in a single frame") whenever the tree was built, for inspection or a screen reader. A claim through the handle that already holds the focus now takes over, so the innermost node of a shared handle is focused; claims through two handles still panic. New group `crates/gpui/tests/a11y_shared_focus.rs`.
